PROCEDURE Query_Master_Details(rel_id Relation,detail VARCHAR2) IS
 oldmsg VARCHAR2(2); -- Old Message Level Setting
 reldef VARCHAR2(5); -- Relation Deferred Setting
BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Variable(s)
 --
 reldef := Get_Relation_Property(rel_id, DEFERRED_COORDINATION);
 oldmsg := :System.Message_Level;
 --
 -- If NOT Deferred, Goto detail and execute the query.
 --
 IF reldef = 'FALSE' THEN
 Go_Block(detail);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 :System.Message_Level := '10';
 Execute_Query;
 :System.Message_Level := oldmsg;
 ELSE
 --
 -- Relation is deferred, mark the detail block as un-coordinated
 --
 Set_Block_Property(detail, COORDINATION_STATUS, NON_COORDINATED);
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN Form_Trigger_Failure THEN
 :System.Message_Level := oldmsg;
 RAISE;
END Query_Master_Details;

ProgramUnit.Name: CLEAR_ALL_MASTER_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Clear_All_Master_Details IS
 mastblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Initial Master Block Causing Coord
 coordop VARCHAR2(30); -- Operation Causing the Coord
 trigblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Cur Block On-Clear-Details Fires On
 startitm VARCHAR2(61); -- Item in which cursor started
 frmstat VARCHAR2(15); -- Form Status
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 curdtl VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Detail Block

 FUNCTION First_Changed_Block_Below(Master VARCHAR2)
 RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 retblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Return Block
 BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Vars
 --
 curblk := Master;
 currel := Get_Block_Property(curblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 --
 -- While there exists another relation for this block
 --
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 --
 -- Get the name of the detail block
 --
 curblk := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 --
 -- If this block has changes, return its name
 --
 IF ( Get_Block_Property(curblk, STATUS) = 'CHANGED' ) THEN
 RETURN curblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- No changes, recursively look for changed blocks below
 --
 retblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(curblk);
 --
 -- If some block below is changed, return its name
 --
 IF retblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 RETURN retblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- Consider the next relation
 --
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- No changed blocks were found
 --
 RETURN NULL;
 END First_Changed_Block_Below;

BEGIN
 --
 -- Init Local Vars
 --
 mastblk := :System.Master_Block;
 coordop := :System.Coordination_Operation;
 trigblk := :System.Trigger_Block;
 startitm := :System.Cursor_Item;
 frmstat := :System.Form_Status;

 --
 -- If the coordination operation is anything but CLEAR_RECORD or
 -- SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS, then continue checking.
 --
 IF coordop NOT IN ('CLEAR_RECORD', 'SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS') THEN
 --
 -- If we're processing the driving master block...
 --
 IF mastblk = trigblk THEN
 --
 -- If something in the form is changed, find the
 -- first changed block below the master
 --
 IF frmstat = 'CHANGED' THEN
 curblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(mastblk);
 --
 -- If we find a changed block below, go there
 -- and Ask to COMMIT_FORM the changes.
 --
 IF curblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 Go_Block(curblk);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(ASK_COMMIT);
 --
 -- If user cancels COMMIT_FORM dialog, raise error
 --
 IF NOT ( :System.Form_Status = 'QUERY'
 OR :System.Block_Status = 'NEW' ) THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 --
 -- Clear all the detail blocks for this master without
 -- any further asking to commit.
 --
 currel := Get_Block_Property(trigblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 curdtl := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 IF Get_Block_Property(curdtl, STATUS) <> 'NEW' THEN
 Go_Block(curdtl);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(NO_VALIDATE);
 IF :System.Block_Status <> 'NEW' THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- Put cursor back where it started
 --
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN Form_Trigger_Failure THEN
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 END IF;
 RAISE;

END Clear_All_Master_Details;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION DO_medical_chk RETURN CHAR IS

 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 -- Similarity thresholds
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 C_UNRELATED_SIMILARITY CONSTANT NUMBER := 85;
 C_CC_HPI_SIMILARITY CONSTANT NUMBER := 96;
 C_SIGNS_HPI_SIMILARITY CONSTANT NUMBER := 92;

 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 -- Original validation activation date
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 C_VALIDATION_START_DATE CONSTANT DATE :=
 TO_DATE('11/08/2026', 'DD/MM/YYYY');

 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 -- Original variables
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 V_PAT PATIENT%ROWTYPE;
 V_MSG VARCHAR2(1000);
 V_VS_IS_MUST VARCHAR2(1);
 V_AGE NUMBER;
 V_B_DATE DATE;
 V_TODAY DATE DEFAULT SYSDATE;
 V_SYS_CAT_TYPE VARCHAR2(10);
 V_EDIT_TIME VARCHAR2(20);
 V_DAY_CAL NUMBER;
 V_CLINIC_ID NUMBER;

 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 -- New validation variables
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 V_ERROR VARCHAR2(4000);
 V_HAS_DIAGNOSTIC_RESULTS VARCHAR2(1);


 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 -- Display message and reject saving
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 FUNCTION REJECT_ENTRY (
 P_MESSAGE IN VARCHAR2,
 P_ITEM_NAME IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL
 ) RETURN CHAR IS
 BEGIN
 MESSAG(P_MESSAGE);

 IF P_ITEM_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN
 BEGIN
 GO_ITEM(P_ITEM_NAME);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 NULL;
 END;
 END IF;

 RETURN 'N';
 END REJECT_ENTRY;


 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 -- Normalize text for comparison
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 FUNCTION NORMALIZE_TEXT (
 P_TEXT IN VARCHAR2
 ) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 V_TEXT VARCHAR2(32767);
 BEGIN
 IF P_TEXT IS NULL THEN
 RETURN NULL;
 END IF;

 V_TEXT := LOWER(TRIM(P_TEXT));

 V_TEXT := REPLACE(V_TEXT, CHR(13), ' ');
 V_TEXT := REPLACE(V_TEXT, CHR(10), ' ');
 V_TEXT := REPLACE(V_TEXT, CHR(9), ' ');

 V_TEXT := REGEXP_REPLACE(
 V_TEXT,
 '[[:space:]]+',
 ' '
 );

 V_TEXT := REGEXP_REPLACE(
 V_TEXT,
 '[^a-z0-9 ]',
 ''
 );

 V_TEXT := REGEXP_REPLACE(
 V_TEXT,
 '[[:space:]]+',
 ' '
 );

 RETURN TRIM(V_TEXT);
 END NORMALIZE_TEXT;


 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 -- Count English words
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 FUNCTION WORD_COUNT (
 P_TEXT IN VARCHAR2
 ) RETURN NUMBER IS
 V_TEXT VARCHAR2(32767);
 BEGIN
 V_TEXT := NORMALIZE_TEXT(P_TEXT);

 IF V_TEXT IS NULL THEN
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;

 RETURN REGEXP_COUNT(
 V_TEXT,
 '[a-z]+'
 );
 END WORD_COUNT;


 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 -- Validate one clinical documentation field
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 FUNCTION CLINICAL_TEXT_ERROR (
 P_TEXT IN VARCHAR2,
 P_FIELD_LABEL IN VARCHAR2,
 P_MIN_WORDS IN NUMBER,
 P_MIN_CHARACTERS IN NUMBER,
 P_ALLOW_EMPTY IN CHAR DEFAULT 'N'
 ) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS

 V_ORIGINAL VARCHAR2(32767);
 V_NORMALIZED VARCHAR2(32767);
 V_COMPACT VARCHAR2(32767);
 V_WORDS NUMBER;
 V_LETTER_COUNT NUMBER;
 V_TEXT_LENGTH NUMBER;

 BEGIN
 V_ORIGINAL := TRIM(P_TEXT);

 -----------------------------------------------------------------------
 -- Empty value
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF V_ORIGINAL IS NULL THEN
 IF NVL(UPPER(P_ALLOW_EMPTY), 'N') = 'Y' THEN
 RETURN NULL;
 END IF;

 RETURN P_FIELD_LABEL || ' is required.';
 END IF;

 -----------------------------------------------------------------------
 -- English only
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF REGEXP_LIKE(
 V_ORIGINAL,
 '[?-?]'
 )
 THEN
 RETURN P_FIELD_LABEL ||
 ' must be entered in English only.';
 END IF;

 -----------------------------------------------------------------------
 -- Must contain English letters
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF NOT REGEXP_LIKE(
 V_ORIGINAL,
 '[A-Za-z]'
 )
 THEN
 RETURN P_FIELD_LABEL ||
 ' must contain meaningful English clinical text.';
 END IF;

 V_NORMALIZED := NORMALIZE_TEXT(V_ORIGINAL);
 V_COMPACT := REPLACE(V_NORMALIZED, ' ', '');
 V_WORDS := WORD_COUNT(V_ORIGINAL);
 V_TEXT_LENGTH := LENGTH(V_ORIGINAL);

 IF V_NORMALIZED IS NULL THEN
 RETURN P_FIELD_LABEL ||
 ' must contain meaningful English clinical text.';
 END IF;

 V_LETTER_COUNT :=
 LENGTH(
 REGEXP_REPLACE(
 V_ORIGINAL,
 '[^A-Za-z]',
 ''
 )
 );

 -----------------------------------------------------------------------
 -- Reject one-character input
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF NVL(V_LETTER_COUNT, 0) < 2 THEN
 RETURN P_FIELD_LABEL ||
 ' must contain meaningful English clinical text.';
 END IF;

 -----------------------------------------------------------------------
 -- Reject generic / insufficient values
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF V_NORMALIZED IN (
 'a','b','c','d','e','f','g','h','i','j','k','l','m',
 'n','o','p','q','r','s','t','u','v','w','x','y','z',
 'aa','bb','cc','dd','ee','xx','xxx',
 'na','n a','nil','none','no','yes','ok','okay','done',
 'same','as above','same as above','see above',
 'unknown','not known','not available','not applicable',
 'unchanged','positive','negative','stable','normal',
 'fine','good','well','all good','nothing',
 'nothing significant','no comment','no comments',
 'noted','reviewed','checked'
 ) THEN
 RETURN P_FIELD_LABEL ||
 ' contains a generic or insufficient value.';
 END IF;

 -----------------------------------------------------------------------
 -- Minimum meaningful characters
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF LENGTH(V_COMPACT) < NVL(P_MIN_CHARACTERS, 3) THEN
 RETURN P_FIELD_LABEL ||
 ' must contain at least ' ||
 TO_CHAR(P_MIN_CHARACTERS) ||
 ' meaningful characters.';
 END IF;

 -----------------------------------------------------------------------
 -- Minimum English words
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF V_WORDS < NVL(P_MIN_WORDS, 1) THEN
 RETURN P_FIELD_LABEL ||
 ' must contain at least ' ||
 TO_CHAR(P_MIN_WORDS) ||
 ' meaningful English words.';
 END IF;

 -----------------------------------------------------------------------
 -- Reject numbers / punctuation only
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF REGEXP_LIKE(
 V_ORIGINAL,
 '^[[:space:][:punct:]0-9]+$'
 )
 THEN
 RETURN P_FIELD_LABEL ||
 ' cannot contain numbers or symbols only.';
 END IF;

 -----------------------------------------------------------------------
 -- Reject one repeated character
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF REGEXP_LIKE(
 V_COMPACT,
 '^([a-z0-9])\1+$',
 'i'
 )
 THEN
 RETURN P_FIELD_LABEL ||
 ' contains repeated or meaningless characters.';
 END IF;

 -----------------------------------------------------------------------
 -- Reject excessive repeated letters
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF REGEXP_LIKE(
 V_NORMALIZED,
 '([a-z])\1{4,}',
 'i'
 )
 THEN
 RETURN P_FIELD_LABEL ||
 ' contains excessive repeated characters.';
 END IF;

 -----------------------------------------------------------------------
 -- Reject repeated single word
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF REGEXP_LIKE(
 V_NORMALIZED,
 '^([a-z0-9]+)( \1)+$',
 'i'
 )
 THEN
 RETURN P_FIELD_LABEL ||
 ' contains the same word repeated several times.';

 END IF;

 IF V_TEXT_LENGTH > 0

 END IF;

 EXCEPTION

 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 -- Calculate similarity through database wrapper
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 FUNCTION TEXT_SIMILARITY (
 P_TEXT_1 IN VARCHAR2,
 P_TEXT_2 IN VARCHAR2
 ) RETURN NUMBER IS

 V_TEXT_1 VARCHAR2(4000);
 V_TEXT_2 VARCHAR2(4000);
 V_RESULT NUMBER;

 BEGIN
 V_TEXT_1 := SUBSTR(
 NORMALIZE_TEXT(P_TEXT_1),
 1,
 4000
 );

 V_TEXT_2 := SUBSTR(
 NORMALIZE_TEXT(P_TEXT_2),
 1,
 4000
 );

 IF V_TEXT_1 IS NULL OR V_TEXT_2 IS NULL THEN
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;

 IF V_TEXT_1 = V_TEXT_2 THEN
 RETURN 100;
 END IF;

 SELECT GET_TEXT_SIMILARITY(
 V_TEXT_1,
 V_TEXT_2
 )
 INTO V_RESULT
 FROM DUAL;

 RETURN NVL(V_RESULT, 0);

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 RAISE;
 END TEXT_SIMILARITY;


 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 -- Detect exact copy, containment, or excessive similarity
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 FUNCTION COPY_TEXT_ERROR (
 P_TEXT_1 IN VARCHAR2,
 P_FIELD_1_LABEL IN VARCHAR2,
 P_TEXT_2 IN VARCHAR2,
 P_FIELD_2_LABEL IN VARCHAR2,
 P_SIMILARITY_LIMIT IN NUMBER,
 P_MIN_COMPARE_LENGTH IN NUMBER DEFAULT 20,
 P_CHECK_CONTAINMENT IN CHAR DEFAULT 'Y'
 ) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS

 V_TEXT_1 VARCHAR2(4000);
 V_TEXT_2 VARCHAR2(4000);
 V_SHORT_LENGTH NUMBER;
 V_LONG_LENGTH NUMBER;
 V_LENGTH_RATIO NUMBER;
 V_SIMILARITY NUMBER;

 BEGIN
 V_TEXT_1 := SUBSTR(
 NORMALIZE_TEXT(P_TEXT_1),
 1,
 4000
 );

 V_TEXT_2 := SUBSTR(
 NORMALIZE_TEXT(P_TEXT_2),
 1,
 4000
 );

 IF V_TEXT_1 IS NULL OR V_TEXT_2 IS NULL THEN
 RETURN NULL;
 END IF;

 -----------------------------------------------------------------------
 -- Exact match is always rejected before checking text length
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF V_TEXT_1 = V_TEXT_2 THEN
 RETURN P_FIELD_2_LABEL ||
 ' is identical to ' ||
 P_FIELD_1_LABEL ||
 '. Please document each section separately.';
 END IF;

 V_SHORT_LENGTH :=
 LEAST(
 LENGTH(V_TEXT_1),
 LENGTH(V_TEXT_2)
 );

 V_LONG_LENGTH :=
 GREATEST(
 LENGTH(V_TEXT_1),
 LENGTH(V_TEXT_2)
 );

 IF V_LONG_LENGTH = 0 THEN
 RETURN NULL;
 END IF;

 V_LENGTH_RATIO :=
 V_SHORT_LENGTH / V_LONG_LENGTH;

 -----------------------------------------------------------------------
 -- Very short non-identical text:
 -- exact equality was already checked above
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF V_SHORT_LENGTH < NVL(P_MIN_COMPARE_LENGTH, 20) THEN
 RETURN NULL;
 END IF;

 -----------------------------------------------------------------------
 -- One field substantially contained inside the other
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF NVL(UPPER(P_CHECK_CONTAINMENT), 'Y') = 'Y'
 AND V_LENGTH_RATIO >= 0.70
 AND (
 INSTR(V_TEXT_1, V_TEXT_2) > 0
 OR
 INSTR(V_TEXT_2, V_TEXT_1) > 0
 )
 THEN
 RETURN P_FIELD_2_LABEL ||
 ' appears to contain text copied from ' ||
 P_FIELD_1_LABEL ||
 '. Please enter information specific to this section.';
 END IF;

 -----------------------------------------------------------------------
 -- Edit-distance similarity
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------
 V_SIMILARITY :=
 TEXT_SIMILARITY(
 V_TEXT_1,
 V_TEXT_2
 );

 IF V_SIMILARITY >= P_SIMILARITY_LIMIT
 AND V_LENGTH_RATIO >= 0.65
 THEN
 RETURN P_FIELD_2_LABEL ||
 ' is highly similar to ' ||
 P_FIELD_1_LABEL ||
 ' (' ||
 TO_CHAR(V_SIMILARITY) ||
 '% similarity). Please document each section separately.';
 END IF;

 RETURN NULL;

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 RETURN 'Unable to compare ' ||
 P_FIELD_1_LABEL ||
 ' with ' ||
 P_FIELD_2_LABEL ||
 '. Error: ' ||
 SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 200);
 END COPY_TEXT_ERROR;
